text.p: Dun & Bradstreet Corp said on Friday it has completed its strategic restructuring into three separate, publicly held companies, including the spinoffs of Cognizant Corp and ACNielsen Corp.

Volney Taylor, who had been executive vice president of Dun & Bradstreet, would become chairman and chief executive officer of the restructured Dun & Bradstreet, effective immediately, the company said.

Dun & Bradstreet now consisted of three franchises -- Dun & Bradstreet, the operating company formerly known as Dun & Bradstreet Information Services, Moody's Investors Service and Reuben H. Donnelley.

Stock certificates for Cognizant and ACNielsen were being distributed and "regular way" trading would being on the New York Stock Exchange for each of the three independent companies, Dun & Bradstreet said.
Cognizant Corp would trade under the symbol CZT.N, ACNielsen Corp would trade under the symbol ART.N and the restructured Dun & Bradstreet would trade under the symbol, the company said.

Under the reorganization, the company has said Nicholos Trivisonno, executive vice president of finance and chief financial officer of Dun & Bradstreet, would become chairman of ACNeilsen, and Robert Weissman, chairman and chief executive officer of Dun & Bradstreet, would become chairman and chief executive officer of Cognizant.
